name: DFX Social Node
description: A DFX node template with social media integration capabilities, featuring Telegram Bot API integration for message sending and bot management.
author: Droq Team

social/telegram/message.description: Statelessly send plain text messages to Telegram chats via Bot API. Supports caller-supplied bot tokens, text formatting (Markdown/HTML), and optional parameters like web preview control and silent notifications.
social/telegram/message.author: Droq Team
